description: Research adequacy review (#2017, Epic #2011 Phase 6). Answers whether a research result may be used as the ground for requirements, design and plan. #2017 deliberately does not mint a dedicated research artifact kind: the write-up arrives inside the generic `artifacts` input, so no vocabulary is added to schemas/review-intent.schema.json or schemas/agent-contract.schema.json before real usage justifies it. Freshness and source availability are the two judgments this Flow must not assert as facts, because the Non-goals of #2017 exclude a built-in web search: the Flow therefore routes them through verify-findings and human-escalation instead of letting them reach derive-gate as verdicts.

inputs.name: artifacts
inputs.description: The review subject as supplied by the host, including the research write-up and whatever sources it carries with it.

inputs.name: requirements
inputs.description: Requirements the research is cited as the ground for. Optional: absence degrades the claim-versus-use cross-check rather than stopping the Flow.

inputs.name: design
inputs.description: Design the research is cited as the ground for. Optional: absence skips the design cross-check.

inputs.name: plan
inputs.description: Plan the research is cited as the ground for. Optional: absence skips the plan cross-check.

steps.description: Missing `artifacts` stops here (required input): with no write-up there is no subject.
Existing upstream-phase selection; no Flow-local list.
Claim-to-source correspondence, fact versus inference, alternatives considered, and unresolved unknowns, judged on the write-up itself.
Research claims against the requirements they are cited for. Runs unconditionally; without requirements it degrades to a write-up-internal review and records the degradation.
Research claims against the design they are cited for.
Research claims against the plan they are cited for.

Evidence gate for the two judgments #2017 forbids asserting as facts. A candidate finding that a source is stale, superseded or missing must cite something in the supplied artifacts; one that cannot does not survive this step and is never restated as a fact downstream.

Freshness and source availability that cannot be settled from the supplied artifacts leave the run as an open question for a person, not as a verdict. Degrades to recording the open question when no escalation channel is available.
